object_description: compound building of a horizontal research part and a vertical teaching part
design_condition: the building connects without ostentation to the linear order of the major institutional axis while conversing with the existing campus masses, reinforcing the axis and concluding it in a low square

positive: The project fits with great subtlety into the difficult meeting of the two constructed fabrics
It connects without ostentation to the linear order of the major axis
It plays jointly on horizontal emanation and vertical conclusion
It skilfully converses with the existing masses of the campus
The exterior spaces are assumed and clarified by the new construction
The status of the main axis is reinforced and concluded in a low square
This ensures the connection with the avenue and an entrance to the university site
The simplicity, elegance and precision of the contextualisation make it a model of urban efficiency
The responsible construction of the territory here calls for a change in the territorial paradigm
Scale relationships with existing buildings are controlled
This densification does not come at the price of promiscuity
The articulation into two distinct but continuous parts does not harm the unity of the project
The programmatic addition is skilfully resolved in a compound building
Spatial qualities lie in a temperate alternation of densities and breathing
The confinement of the laboratories is matched by the openings to the patios
Spaces for meeting and exchange are regularly scattered in the rational density of the plans
The floors are more variations than repetitions
The building is understood and practised as a family of relatively autonomous clusters
The internal flexibility of the spaces is considered good
The research volume premises are well lit apart from the lower level
The upper teaching volume is well lit including in its corridors
The natural summer ventilation is convincing
The structural principles are reasonable and simple with well regulated spans
Structure and architecture are in good conversation
The estimated cost is exactly within target and floor areas correspond precisely to the programme
negative: The clear spatial vision is sometimes at the expense of the requested programmatic structure
Laboratories on a separate floor from the offices do not promote essential exchanges
Common rooms should be accessible to everyone and not exclusively to group labs
Practical work rooms over five levels pose logistical problems needing more supervision
Certain user flows are problematic, including technical access and goods delivery
Circulation between group laboratories and common premises is not satisfactory
A deficit in cleaning and storage rooms exists though it can be corrected
The ventilated double skin facade is incomprehensible and prohibitive for the energy target
The double skin principle is anachronistic and useless, though removable without harm
Fan coil conditioning is not adapted to an efficient building with high internal loads
